evidenceLevelDefinitions.E1: Owning source or contract exists at the recorded revision.
evidenceLevelDefinitions.E2: The named executable test or benchmark passed in its stated scope.
evidenceLevelDefinitions.E3: The named build or package step succeeded for the recorded source.
evidenceLevelDefinitions.E4: The recorded artifact was installed through the named product path.
evidenceLevelDefinitions.E5: The installed or current Runtime produced the recorded authoritative event or state.
evidenceLevelDefinitions.E6: A real user-visible foreground interaction satisfied the recorded acceptance.

claimPolicy.deterministicVsJudge: Exact counters, timings, hashes, test outcomes, retrieval metrics, and state transitions remain deterministic fields. AI Judge outputs must be labeled ai_estimate and never replace ground truth.
claimPolicy.proofBoundary: Source, tests, build, install, Runtime, foreground acceptance, and release readiness are independent claims.
claimPolicy.sampleBoundary: Repeated observations improve timing stability but do not increase the number of unique cases.
claimPolicy.snapshotBoundary: A tracked historical receipt may support a revision-qualified interview claim; it does not prove the current dirty worktree or current installed foreground.

inventory.note: Counts describe the current source inventory only; they are not quality or completion metrics.

the current checkout contains the scorecard and hashes but not the ignored private source report

metrics.title: Memory optimizer deterministic case gate

claim.allowed: 16 个 Memory optimizer 行为 case 重复 3 轮共 48 次全部通过，并为每次保存 Trace；本机端到端 p95 37 ms。
claim.forbidden: 48 个独立样本、LongMemEval 质量 100%、生产前台延迟 37 ms。

limitations: case fixtures are synthetic and deterministic
three repeats are timing observations, not 48 unique cases
not an installed foreground measurement

metrics.title: Hybrid Memory retrieval safety and latency case gate

claim.allowed: 4 个多路召回/安全 case 重复 3 轮全部通过，本机 p95 8 ms，fixture 中原句、旧输入、墓碑和重复候选泄漏率均为 0。
claim.forbidden: 真实用户数据零泄漏、公开检索集 Recall@3 为 100%、生产端到端 p95 8 ms。

limitations: small synthetic case set
vector-tag boost win rate remained 0.0 in these fixtures
not a foreground or public-dataset result

metrics.title: Explicit Active RAG readiness and privacy case gate

claim.allowed: 3 个 Active RAG case 重复 3 轮共 9 次全部 ready，最大 ready 时间 45 ms，fixture 检查未泄露 selected text 且 stale accept 全部拒绝。
claim.forbidden: 真实 macOS 选区替换已经验收、所有隐私路径零泄漏、或用户可见 TTFC 为 45 ms。

limitations: local core-mode fixture
foreground capture, replacement, commit, and feedback remain unverified

metrics.title: Session recall query/summary blend micro-eval

claim.allowed: 6-case 微评测中，0.8 query + 0.2 compaction-summary 向量融合把有用命中从 4 提到 6，并把无关注入从 2 降到 0。
claim.forbidden: 通用 Recall 提升 50%、跨项目永不泄漏、或六题等于真实多轮对话分布。

limitations: six deterministic fixtures only
task-labeled rather than generic relevance judgments
selected context bytes increased from 192 to 264

metrics.title: Governed workspace search versus Python scan

claim.allowed: 在结果 checksum 完全一致的 1k/5k 合成工作区上，受治理的 rg 搜索相对 Python 扫描取得 2.14x/4.40x 的 p95 加速。
claim.forbidden: 所有仓库搜索都快 4.40 倍、真实生产吞吐提升 4.40 倍、或该结果没有环境依赖。

limitations: synthetic sparse literal search corpus
single macOS arm64 host with Python 3.14.6 and 10 logical CPUs
fresh summary is recorded here; historical raw sample arrays remain in the two referenced receipts
